scenario.summary: Guest searches a simple product, adds it to the cart and opens the cart. Head of the shipping-cost chain (validation, free and paid shipping methods depend on it).
steps: Search the simple SKU and open it
stateChanges: Guest cart: one simple product added (kept for the dependent methods)
assertions: Search box and Add to Cart visible (page-object checks)
evidence: Class chain, first method captures (user decision 2026-11-04): this method runs first and declares every need and record value of the chain; the migrated class keeps the resolved record in a class field and the later methods read that field, so they have no needs of their own. Consumers: ShippingCostPageValidation, FreeShippingCost and PaidShippingCost read no product value (cart state only) and have no needs.
The dependent methods never read the product's values (they check shipping estimates on the cart), so the preferred sheet SKU is safe here.
Profile (Playwright observations): z-2420004 is an active SimpleProduct (BlackAndDecker) in PRODUCTION, inventory 235, required add-ons 0.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); Playwright observations of the same SKUs are cited where they exist.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
